topic: Eye strain headaches: why they happen after screens/reading

youtube.title: Headache after screens? Quick quiz 🤯💻 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Headache after hours on a screen or a book: is it your eyes, the screen, or both?
திரை பார்த்த பின் தலைவலி ஏன்? பதில் இதோ.

• Up close, a tiny focusing muscle in your eye works nonstop, and you blink less, so eyes dry out.
• Eye strain doesn't permanently damage your eyes, but even a small uncorrected power can make headaches worse.
• 20-20-20: every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds.
• Keep the screen an arm's length away, slightly below eye level, with no window glare.
• Blink fully and often; read in good light.
• Urgent: a sudden severe headache with eye pain, redness, blurred vision or rainbow halos needs an eye specialist the same day.

gmb.text: Why do screens and reading give you a headache? Up close, a small focusing muscle inside the eye works nonstop, and we blink less, so the eyes dry out. Eye strain does not permanently damage the eyes, but even a small uncorrected power can make headaches worse. Try the 20-20-20 rule (every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds), keep the screen an arm's length away and slightly below eye level, avoid window glare, blink fully and read in good light. See an eye specialist urgently if a sudden severe headache comes with eye pain, redness, blurred vision or halos around lights. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
